headline: P-loop 10–17 is the leading construct-specific model-reliability region, but no primary ligand pocket can be assigned from these predictions alone.
recommendation: Use residues 10–17 as provisional construct-specific model-reliability/design guidance, not as an inhibitor-pocket assignment.
structure_check: WT AlphaFold reference: single-chain KRAS G12, residues 1–189; actual assay construct: single-chain KRAS G12D, residues 1–169. D12 lies inside P-loop 10–17.
assembly: Single-chain model; no multi-chain assembly or interface interpretation applies.
caveat: The two computational predictions differ, and neither defines nucleotide loading or compound occupancy. The P-loop leads for construct-specific model reliability, but no primary ligand pocket can be assigned.
